ontology: Domain: peatland fire detections (this is a fire study, not flood, not earthquake — frame accordingly). Processes such surveys consider include: hotspots burning out under suppression; smoldering peat surviving rain and restarting days later; spread into new grid cells downwind; containment holding at surveyed lines; flare-ups on previously quiet cells; or full cessation with no restart. These are vocabulary, not answers: you may adopt, adapt, or reject any of them, but your set must stay open and include a cessation story with real weight. Ground every weight in the ledger below, not in the vocabulary above.
prompt_framing: Context: a peat-fire detection survey, five pre-cutoff days, anonymous grid cells. Below is the evidence ledger (pre-cutoff aggregates only).
